name: Microplans — Service Delivery Overlay
narrative: A planner uses real service-delivery GPS to decide where to plan: overlay an opportunity's visits on the map, then turn the delivery footprint itself into a planning area

maya.intro: Maya is deciding how to plan field coverage for a region. Before she draws a single boundary, she wants to see where service delivery has actually happened — and ideally let that real footprint do the work of defining the area.
maya.name: Maya Okonkwo
